title: Never Similar in Size - Hard to Give as Gifts
text: Never Similar in Size - Hard to Give as Gifts. Why can't they put two that are at least of similar in size together?  The few I have tried have all been terribly mismatched, making them very hard to give as gifts.  They don't look nearly as good as they could when placed near each other.  I find the lack of quality control on all WBM products disappointing and infuriating.
